portugal_policy.title: 🇵🇹 Portugal Policy & Law
portugal_policy.content:
No significant laws, decree-laws, or regulations were approved or entered into force between November 16 and November 22, 2026.

Watch list: The 2027 State Budget (OE2027) is currently under debate in the Assembleia da República; investors should specifically monitor the final wording regarding IRC (Corporate Income Tax) rate adjustments for SMEs and the updated criteria for residential rental tax exemptions under the "Mais Habitação" framework.

Why it matters: The 2027 State Budget will establish the primary tax obligations and investment incentives for all businesses and citizens in Portugal for the upcoming fiscal year.

ai_tools_snapshot.title: AI Tools Snapshot
ai_tools_snapshot.content:
AI TOOLS SNAPSHOT
Category | Pedro uses | Best today | Alternative | Cost/Plan | Migration effort | Switch? | Reason
Coding / Agents | Claude Code + GPT Codex | Claude Code | GitHub Copilot | Free/Sub | Low | Optimal | Claude Code's agentic terminal integration is currently the gold standard.
Excel / Spreadsheets | Claude.ai | Claude.ai | Rows.com | Free tier | Low | Optimal | Claude's analysis tool handles complex logic better than integrated sheet AI.
Presentations | Claude.ai | Gamma | Tome | Free tier | Medium | Consider | Gamma automates visual layout and slide design, which Claude cannot do.
Documents / Word | Claude.ai | Claude.ai | Notion AI | $10/mo | Low | Optimal | Claude Pro drafting is superior for technical documentation and structure.
LaTeX / Overleaf | Overleaf + Claude.ai | Overleaf + Claude.ai | Typst | Free | Medium | Consider | Typst is a faster, modern alternative to LaTeX for technical users.
Knowledge Management | Claude.ai | Obsidian | Notion | Free | High | Upgrade | Claude is a chat interface; Obsidian provides actual long-term structural knowledge.
Image Generation | GPT-4o / Nano Banana 2 | Flux.1 | Midjourney v6 | Free tier | Low | Consider | Flux.1 offers superior prompt adherence and text rendering in images.
Research / Web Search | Perplexity | Perplexity | SearchGPT | Free/Sub | Low | Optimal | Perplexity remains the most robust source-cited research engine.
Transcription / Audio | None | OpenAI Whisper | Otter.ai | Free (Local) | Low | Not using | Whisper (run locally) provides state-of-the-art accuracy for free.
Task Automation | Claude.ai | Zapier Central | Make.com | Free tier | Medium | Upgrade | Claude writes scripts; Zapier Central actually executes cross-app workflows autonomously.

Takeaway: Migrate your knowledge management from Claude Projects to Obsidian to build a permanent, local technical database.
